scope: Corollary 5.10 (Formal data in large positive characteristic) of the manuscript “A boundary-only obstruction to four-dimensional disk embedding” (preprints/A-boundary-only-obstruction-to-four-dimensional-disk-embedding-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 305 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cb5bb77f6a673a3d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every sufficiently large rational prime ℓ, the ring R in Theorem 5.8 has a homomorphism to a finite field k of characteristic ℓ. Reducing every coefficient by such a homomorphism gives separated potentials of order at least three, the identities (5.17) with their witnesses, and the two complementary zero graphs over k. In particular ℓ can be chosen larger than any prescribed finite bound.
